• inheritance, and refactor monolithic code into maintainable, testable modules.

slides.label: KEY IDEA 01
slides.title: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Composition
slides.body: Encapsulation hides internal state behind a public interface. Inheritance defines an is-a relationship — a Dog is an Animal. Polymorphism allows different types to satisfy the same interface. Composition defines a has-a relationship — a Car has an Engine.

slides.label: KEY IDEA 02
slides.title: SOLID Principles
slides.body: Single Responsibility: A class should have one reason to change. An LLMService should not also handle caching, rate limiting, and logging.

slides.label: KEY IDEA 03
slides.title: GoF Patterns for AI Engineering
slides.body: Strategy Pattern: Define a family of algorithms, encapsulate each, and make them interchangeable. In AI this means swapping inference backends (OpenAI, Anthropic, local), vector stores (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant), or embedding models.

slides.label: KEY IDEA 04
slides.title: Clean Architecture
slides.body: Dependency rule: source code dependencies point inwards. Outer layers (frameworks, databases, APIs) depend on inner layers (business logic, entities). Inner layers never depend on outer layers.
